strategy_roster.name: MACD RSI
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) crossing its signal while RSI(14) rises back above 30 implements the long entry. A bearish MACD cross is the state-free exit proxy for the opposite signal; the documented percentage stop is 2%.

strategy_roster.name: NY Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Thirty prior bars proxy the 13:00-13:30 UTC range because DSL has no clock filter. A close above its prior high enters long and a close below the opposite prior boundary proxies the range stop; the 2R target and boundary stop are session-relative, not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Ultimate Stochastics
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing up from oversold while remaining below 40 is the explicit proxy for %K crossing %D below oversold; crossing down from 70 proxies the opposite signal. Stochastic %K/%D and unsupplied optional percent stop/target values are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Adam and Eve
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(sma(close,5),1) > 0 and roc(sma(close,7),1) > 0 and roc(sma(close,9),1) > 0 and roc(sma(close,10),1) > 0 and roc(sma(close,12),1) > 0 and roc(sma(close,14),1) > 0 and roc(sma(close,20),1) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish candle proxies the Heikin-Ashi no-lower-wick condition, and positive ROC of every documented SMA in the 5/7/9/10/12/14/20 stack preserves their rising slopes. A one-bar move of at least ATR(14), expressed in percent, proxies the entry-relative ATR target; no stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Blau TS Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: The documented Breakdown-mode long condition is a histogram break from above to below zero, so a downward RSI(14) zero-line break is the explicit bounded-oscillator proxy; the upward break exits. Blau smoothing, Twist/CloudTwist modes, applied-price shifts, and point-based protection cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: BB Swing
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,20) > ema(close,50) and low <= bb_lower(close,20,2) and close - open > sma(close - open,3) and roc(close,10) > 0 and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20,50) proxies the fast/slow LWMA trend, a current lower-Bollinger(20,2) touch proxies the last-three-bar check, expanding body versus its 3-bar average proxies body strengthening, ROC(10)>0 proxies positive higher-timeframe momentum deviation, and MACD(12,26,9)>signal preserves confirmation. A bearish MACD cross is the exit proxy; scaling and money/point risk settings are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: FXF Fast in Fast out
strategy_roster.entry_long: (high + low) / 2 > open and high - low > atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: A candle range above ATR(14) is the scale-free proxy for the volatility threshold, and midpoint above open supplies the bullish pending-stop direction. A midpoint reversal is the state-free trailing/exit proxy; quote spread, order offset, pending-order state, and point-based protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Connect Disconnect Sound Alert
strategy_roster.notes: The source is a connectivity watchdog that explicitly places no orders and documents no entry, exit, stop, or target. The unreachable condition preserves its non-trading behavior.

strategy_roster.name: Gazonkos Expert
strategy_roster.notes: Positive three-bar momentum followed by a one-bar pullback is the state-free proxy for the documented impulse and retracement. Loss of the three-bar impulse is the exit proxy; exact shifted closes, pip thresholds, and fixed pip stop/target distances are not available in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Rubberbands 3
strategy_roster.notes: A positive one-bar break above the prior high proxies expansion above a running maximum; a negative one-bar break below the prior low proxies the BackStep counter-move and sequence exit. Running extremes, pyramiding, reversal sequencing, order limits, and account-currency session targets require state unavailable in the DSL.
